Parabolic Dish:

The dish diameter $D$ determines the gain. It is also important to know where to place the feed. For a direct focus configuration, the focal length is

$$ F = \frac{D^2}{16c}$$,

where $F$ is the focal length and $c$ is the depth measured from the center of the dish to the height equal to the outer rim.
